task.title: Pull Changes
task.shortdesc: Bring the remote's commits into your local branch, by merge or by rebase.

context.p: Pulling downloads the remote commits and integrates them into your current branch. You choose how they're integrated — see if you're unsure which to pick.

step.cmd:
On the
toolbar, open the
drop-down and choose how to integrate the changes.

choices.choice: — creates a merge commit if your branch and the remote have both moved on.
— replays your local commits on top of the remote ones for a linear history.
— pulls from a branch other than the one you're tracking.

info.p: The option you choose between and becomes the default action on the toolbar button.

result.p: If the pull produces conflicts, resolve them before continuing. See .
result.note: A pull that needs to set your changes aside stashes them internally, so it is refused if the working copy has a filesystem name collision. See .
